verbatim_quote.original: اون داره خوب کار می‌کنه. فرقشو سعی کن پیدا کنی و به من توضیح بده و بعد از اینکه کامل فهمیدیش، تسکش کن و توی بک‌لاگ بنویسش.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: That one works fine. Try to find the difference and explain it to me, and after you fully understand it, make it a task and write it in the backlog.

extracted_decision.summary: Search-tab VIP bug: diagnose root cause vs working activity hub, explain, then file a backlog task (became task 844).
extracted_decision.rationale: Bug reports should carry proven diagnosis and land in Kanban rather than ad-hoc fixes.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Slightly slower; full traceability in return.
